hallucination_reason: The anonymized text does not introduce any new information not present in the original.
anonymization_quality_reason: All personally identifiable information (name, job title, company names) and sensitive details (date, money amount) were correctly identified and masked.
reidentification_risk_reason: All direct and indirect identifiers have been removed or generalized, making re-identification impossible from the anonymized text alone.
